title: Add an icon
description: A drawing for the project's icon library: its name, a few words saying what it shows, and the SVG, drawn as the built-in set is (the same box, paths only, one colour, no text). It is reduced to path data and checked; a name is given once.

name.description: `x-`, then what it shows: a singular noun, then a qualifier if needed (`x-encoder`, `x-encoder-audio`). No board names, numbers or colours.

title.description: A few words saying what it shows.

svg.description: The drawing, as SVG: paths only, in the built-in set's box; text, pictures, styles and scripts are refused.

title.description: A few words saying what an icon shows.
